name: B6 Studios
scope: GENERAL outreach only — the wide net. NEVER touch Surviving the Cows, Trashed, or 7 Stories named targets (those are Avi's manual sniper pipelines). Dedupe against them before every send.

targeting.notes: Consumer-facing brands ~$20M+ revenue that already make content or obviously should, with a product/world a short-form series could be built around. Match the ask to seniority: director level and above; never aim a six-figure concept at a coordinator.

_needs_from_avi.from_addresses: dedicated cold sending domains, warmed, separate from b6studios.com (SPEC §8). NEVER send from b6studios.com / mason@b6studios.com.
_needs_from_avi.reply_to: a monitored reply inbox on the cold domain (SPEC §8 reply routing).
_needs_from_avi.calendar_url: the Mason + Weston 15-min booking link (SPEC §7 step 7).
_needs_from_avi.success: target booked-meeting rate and a defensible max cost per meeting, defined up front (SPEC §9).
_needs_from_avi.host_base_url: the domain/CDN that serves per-brand teaser links with view tracking (SPEC §7 step 4).
